name: ferrodsp-am-iq-v1

channels.label: TX coil voltage
channels.path: after C33/C34 -> R29+R32/R35, C38, DA10.2 -> DA9 VINL

channels.label: TX amplifier voltage
channels.path: after C32, before C33/C34 -> R28/R33, C52, DA10.1 -> DA9 VINR

detector.note: No factor of 2 applied; absolute sign/phase includes analogue transfer and ADC/DSP timing.

receiver.device: Sound Blaster G3 SPDIF / Windows WASAPI exclusive
receiver.invalid_samples: Keep valid mask; never fill gaps as actual observations

calibration.method: Per-component linear fit to carrier/pilot amplitude ratio

limitations: Complex envelopes only; full-band ADC samples and harmonics cannot be reconstructed.
Pilot monitors timing quality but is not a CRC or proof of bit transparency.
No ADC clipping flag transmitted; optical clipping test does not establish analogue headroom.
No hardware volts/current calibration; values remain DSP units.
